_comment: Split declarations for every dataset named in EVAL.md §2. The harness reads THIS file,
not the directory layout, to decide which split a row belongs to: a directory depth is
exactly the thing a motivated person would quietly change, and a manifest change is a
splitUnit must be source-doc, identity or none. Splitting by patch or frame is leakage
(EVAL.md §2): two crops of one document share every pixel-level artefact and every
imperfection in the print process, so a model fitted across such a split has already seen
the test data. The harness refuses a manifest that declares anything else and marks the
reportSplit names the split whose numbers may go in the deck. It is the split the
operating point is MEASURED on, not the one it is TUNED on — see threshold_provenance.json.

datasets.note: 70/15/15 by SOURCE document. 256px gray patches, 7 process labels, clip/no-clip x 3 lights. Target >=600 (v1) -> >=1500 (M3). No media is committed (DATA.md §1); this entry declares the policy, not the contents.
Photo-swap/tilt clips plus macro of the boundaries. >=60 docs. Held out entirely: it is validation data, never a fitting target.

Generated valid + single/double mutants, 10k rows. Generated from a fixed seed by dev.kasoti.mrz.MrzCorpus, so there is nothing to split and nothing to leak: the corpus is a function of its seed, and both the generator and the parser are in :core.
Signed-valid + mutated + wrong-key, >=300. Generated in-process with a per-JVM TEST keypair; see dev.kasoti.eval.fixtures.QrFixtures.

Consented pairs (genuine + impostor) plus an LFW subset for sanity only. Split by IDENTITY: both images of one volunteer must sit in the same split, or a 'genuine' pair in the report split is really a re-sighting of a training identity. No media is committed (DATA.md §1, §4).
Print-attack and screen-attack clips, >=120. Held out: a liveness model fitted on attacks it has seen reports a number that is not a detection rate.

40 scripted diary scenarios (alias/travel/facilitator/watchlist). Synthetic by construction: each script states what it plants, so there is no distribution to leak from. Includes benign scripts, because a suite that only plants attacks measures recall and not the false-alarm rate that decides whether a rule is safe to ship.
Novice timed runs plus a GREY drill. Field sessions, not a corpus: the numbers are an operational reading (GREY rate, threshold feel) rather than a model metric.
